pages.description: At MacPaw, we craft software that makes everyday tech life simpler, cleaner, and more enjoyable. From globally loved products like CleanMyMac and Setapp to emerging cybersecurity tools like ClearVPN and Moonlock, we are building a product ecosystem that reaches millions of people worldwide. We believe humans and technology can reach their greatest potential together. By fusing high engineering standards, thoughtful design, and practical AI, we rethink how people interact with their devices and shape the daily tech routines of the future. Working at MacPaw means owning outcomes, not just tasks. We build for global scale from day one, giving you the trust, freedom, and room to experiment. We are looking for a proactive, highly organized, and trustworthy Junior Executive Operations Coordinator based in Kyiv (hybrid format) to support our leadership team. You will play a key role in supporting our Executives, managing day-to-day calendar and workflow coordination across international time zones while providing discreet personal and administrative assistance to C-level leaders. In this role, you will: Take full ownership of executive calendars, efficiently scheduling calls, syncs, and meetings across international time zones (including a 7-hour time difference). Drive cross-functional coordination, prepare meeting agendas, collect pre-read materials, take notes, and ensure structured follow-ups. Support company leadership with administrative tasks, daily reminders, and fast-paced ad-hoc operational requests. Coordinate travel logistics end-to-end, including flights, hotel bookings, itineraries, and last-minute travel updates. Assist C-level leaders with personal administrative requests, local errands, and discreet day-to-day coordination. Facilitate seamless communication and execution between executives, department heads, and cross-functional teams. Skills you’ll need to bring: At least 1 year of experience in administrative support, project coordination, office management, or personal assistance. Upper-Intermediate or higher written and spoken English for daily communication with native speakers, along with fluent Ukrainian. Strong organizational skills, sharp attention to detail, and a proactive approach to keep tasks running smoothly. High level of honesty, integrity, and discretion when handling sensitive business and personal information. Professional maturity with respect for team structure, boundaries, and clear reporting lines. Flexibility to reprioritize quickly and handle occasional urgent scheduling or travel requests outside standard hours. Proficiency with Google Workspace (Calendar, Gmail, Docs) and active daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) for drafting, summarizing, and research. As a plus: Prior experience working across international time zones (especially US time gaps). Familiarity with task management tools such as Jira or Confluence. Strong independent writing skills to draft clear business correspondence, briefs, and executive summaries. Previous experience supporting C-level executives in tech companies or fast-paced startups. What we offer: We are a Ukrainian company, and we stand with Ukraine against the russian aggression We maintain workplaces for the mobilized Macpawians and provide financial support to colleagues or their families affected by the war. Here , you can also read about the MacPaw Foundation, which intends to help save the lives of Ukrainian defenders and provide relief to as many civilians as possible. We are committed to our veterans Our Veteran Career and Empowerment Program is designed to ensure our veterans and active military personnel receive the recognition, support, and opportunities they deserve. Hybrid work model Whether to work remotely or at the hub is entirely up to you. If you decide to mix it, our Kyiv office, which works as a coworking space, is open around the clock. The office is supplied with UPS and Starlink for an uninterrupted work process. Your health always comes first We guarantee medical insurance starting on your first working month. For those abroad, you can receive a yearly Medical insurance allowance as compensation for managing your medical expenses. Flexible working hours You can choose a schedule that is comfortable for you. No one here tracks your clock in/out because MacPaw is built on trust and cooperation. Space to grow both professionally and personally Education opportunities to grow both hard and soft skills, annual development reviews, and internal community. Teams we are proud of We build honest, transparent, and reliable relationships within teams. Every Macpawian can improve processes and implement their ideas. We encourage open and constructive feedback and provide training for Macpawians on giving and receiving feedback. Office designed for people (and pets) Our office has it all: a spacious workplace with enough room for sitting up, lying down, and running around; a gym for recreation; cozy kitchens; a sleeping/meditation room; and a terrace with a view where we throw summer parties. Also, we have two cats living in the office, and you are welcome to bring your pets to the office (we have separate floors for cats and dogs). Time-off policy that covers life’s needs Convenient personal time-off policy to help you take care of essential matters in your personal life, and parental leaves. On top of all that, sabbaticals are open after 5 years of being with MacPaw. Join social initiatives with MacPawCares MacPaw participates in numerous humanitarian aid and charity projects across many fields, and you are welcome to jump in to make the world a better place. We’re an equal-opportunity employer. Here is a safe place for applicants of all backgrounds We are hiring talented humans. Meaning with all our variety of backgrounds and identities, including service members and veterans, women, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals with disabilities, and other often underrepresented groups. MacPaw does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. *Some benefits are under development, and new adjustments are possible. pages.description: Kiss My Apps — це незалежна компанія-платформа, що запускає та розвиває В2С-бізнеси за допомогою Product Engine — AI-інфраструктури, що обʼєднує аналітику, розробку, маркетинг та платежі. Сьогодні на базі платформи масштабуються 20+ B2C-бізнесів, якими користуються 130+ мільйонів користувачів у 150+ країнах світу. З кінця 2022 року Kiss My Apps зросла у понад 70 разів, об’єднавши 300+ спеціалістів, які створюють цифрові продукти в нішах utilities, lifestyle, health & fitness і не тільки. Наш темп — це наш competitive advantage. KMA зростає мінімум х3 рік до року — ми шукаємо Android Developer , того, хто допоможе масштабуватись ще швидше. Коротко про роль: Ми шукаємо досвідченого та ініціативного Android Developer, який приєднається до команди Kiss My Apps та розвиватиме застосунок у ніші дизайну інтер’єру. Продукт, до якого ти долучишся, вже входить у Топ-2 у своїй ніші за Revenue та Downloads . Команда активно досліджує нові можливості, розширює функціонал і має амбітну ціль — стати Топ-1, а далі вийти в суміжні ніші, щоб бути корисними для ще більшої аудиторії. Це можливість не просто писати код, а впливати на розвиток продукту, пропонувати технічні рішення, автоматизувати власну рутину та бачити прямий вплив своєї роботи на продукт. Твої задачі: Розробка Android-застосунку Розробка та підтримка Android-застосунку з фокусом на користувацький досвід. Імплементація UI-компонентів та анімацій відповідно до дизайну. Оптимізація ефективності та швидкодії застосунку. Пошук і пропозиція нових можливостей для покращення поточних та додавання нових функцій застосунку. Робота з командою та продуктом Співпраця з дизайнерами, Product Managers та Backend-командою. Участь у пошуку рішень, які відповідають потребам користувачів та бізнес-цілям. Підтримка технічної документації. CI/CD та якість Підтримка CI/CD процесів. Робота над якістю та підтримуваністю коду. Використання AI-інструментів у щоденній роботі. Що очікуємо від тебе: Android Development Від 2 років комерційного досвіду Android-розробки . Впевнене знання Kotlin: coroutines, Flow, structured concurrency. Практичний досвід розробки UI з використанням Jetpack Compose. Впевнене розуміння принципів SOLID та їх застосування в Android-розробці. Досвід застосування Clean Architecture в Android-проєктах: data / domain / presentation, Use Cases, Repository pattern. Досвід роботи з архітектурними підходами MVVM або MVI. Досвід використання Dependency Injection: Hilt або Koin. Досвід роботи з Git. Активне використання AI-інструментів у щоденній роботі — must have: Claude Code, Copilot або аналоги. Робота з API та даними Досвід інтеграції з API: Retrofit або Ktor. Розуміння REST. Досвід роботи з локальним збереженням даних: Room, DataStore. Soft Skills Вмотивованість та проактивність із фокусом на самостійне просування проєктів уперед. Продуктове мислення, спрямоване на створення user-centric рішень, що відповідають бізнес-цілям. Сильні комунікаційні навички для ефективної співпраці з командою та стейкхолдерами. Аналітичне мислення для оцінки викликів і прийняття data-driven рішень. Буде плюсом Досвід роботи з аналітикою та мобільною атрибуцією: Firebase, Amplitude, AppsFlyer або аналоги. Базове розуміння CI/CD для Android: Fastlane, GitHub Actions або аналоги. Ми пропонуємо: Формат роботи на твій вибір: fully remote з будь-якої точки вільного світу, а також доступ до одного з наших офісів за бажанням (Київ, Варшава). Умови, завдяки яким ти можеш сфокусуватись на перформансі: гідна винагорода, що відповідає твоїм скілам та досвіду. А також ми забезпечуємо технікою незалежно від формату роботи та географії. Кар’єрне зростання через дію: 80%+ усіх leads в Kiss My Apps ще 2-3 роки тому були світчерами. Твій вплив тут не визначається роками в резюме — він визначається тим, як швидко ти навчаєшся, береш відповідальність та береш оунершіп за власну карʼєру. Командні активності: Для підтримки ментального здоров’я нашої команди ми пропонуємо онлайн-заняття йогою двічі на тиждень. Розвиток та професійна реалізація: проводимо внутрішні speaking clubs англійською з нейтів спікером, а також надаємо можливість виступати на внутрішніх та зовнішніх івентах від Kiss My Apps . Крім цього ти матимеш річний бюджет на покриття до 50% професійних конференцій, освітніх подій та івентів. Додаткові бенефіти, де ти обираєш: надаємо фіксований бюджет на рік з якого ти сам обираєш, яку статтю витрат покрити: 50% від медстрахування, психотерапії, спорту чи стоматології. А також 40 днів оплачуваного відпочинку та лікарняних без привʼязки до дат. Опора в умовах війни: забезпечуємо кожного всім необхідним для безперебійної роботи, системно підтримуємо Сили Оборони та долучаємось до ініціатив із відновлення України. Як виглядає hiring процес: Інтро з рекрутером Технічне інтервʼю Фінальне інтервʼю Якщо тобі цікаво будувати внутрішні продукти, які допомагають масштабувати маркетинг AI-продуктів із мільйонами користувачів, запускати нові сервіси практично з нуля та працювати із сучасним стеком технологій — let’s launch the future together 🌱 Активна до: 18 листопада 2026 Оновлена: 17 жовтня 2026 Опублікована: 17 вересня 2026 Як відгукнутись на вакансію? pages.description: ABOUT RETELL AI Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell’s AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we’ve scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B. Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we’re creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world. Let’s build the future together. Recent recognition: No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard Backed by Y Combinator ABOUT THE ROLE We’ve landed the logos. This role exists because keeping and growing them is now the biggest opportunity. You’ll own a book of enterprise accounts from launch onward, the relationship, the consumption number, the renewal, and the expansion. We price on usage, growth here isn’t a repapering exercise: you grow the account by getting more of the customer’s call volume onto Retell, which means you’ll be in the data, in the QBRs, and in the room when they decide what to automate next. KEY RESPONSIBILITY This hire owns net revenue retention across a book of enterprise accounts. Own the post-launch relationship with enterprise buyers and program owners, from first production call through renewal. Grow consumption across the book: pilot to production, one use case to many, one department to the org. Own the renewal: forecast, negotiate, and close it, and find the upsell inside it. Turn usage data into the business case customers use internally to expand. Bring the blockers you find back to Product and Engineering with revenue attached. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Must have: 2+ years in Account Management, Customer Success Management, or another post-sales role where you personally owned a renewal or expansion number at a B2B software company. A track record you can walk through: a specific account, what it was worth when you got it, what it was worth when you left it, and what you did. Comfort with usage data: you can read an adoption dashboard and build a commercial argument out of it. Ability to hold an executive conversation and a hard commercial one in the same meeting. Nice to have: Experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing. Experience with AI, LLMs, or Voice AI. Startup experience. Technical fluency: you can hold your own APIs, integrations, and deployment concepts with a customer’s engineering team. HOW WE EVALUATE We care less about checkboxes and more about: Whether you’ve actually owned a number, not supported someone who did. Judgment in customer-facing moments, especially when something is broken and the renewal is close. Whether you go find the expansion or wait for the customer to raise it. How you reason from data: can you look at a consumption chart and tell us which account is about to churn and why. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF You’d rather own the whole account than hand it off at the renewal. You get more satisfaction from growing an account 3x than from a clean CSAT score. You’re comfortable pushing a customer toward a decision instead of waiting for them. You like being close enough to the product to argue with the roadmap. You move fast and don’t need a playbook to already exist. JOB DETAILS Cash: $180,000 – $220,000 Equity: 4-year vest / 1-year cliff Location: Redwood City, California, onsite (Relocation support provided) US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, and F-1 (OPT/CPT). OTHER BENEFITS 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance $70/day DoorDash credit for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.) $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.) $75/month phone bill reimbursement $50/month internet reimbursement COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY Best offer upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed Top 1% talent: Above-market pay (top 5th percentile) to attract exceptional builders High ownership: small teams, >$1M revenue per employee, and significant equity Performance-based: Offers tied to interview performance, not tenure or past salary INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter screen (30 min) Account strategy walkthrough with the hiring manager (45 min) Account management best practices (30 min) Onsite (2.5 hrs): QBR simulation, escalation role play, usage analytics exercise & cross-functional and founder conversation Активна до: 18 листопада 2026 Оновлена: 17 жовтня 2026 Опублікована: 19 вересня 2026 Як відгукнутись на вакансію? As a Deployment Strategist at Retell, you will work directly with some of the most innovative companies deploying AI-powered voice agents. You will lead implementations from initial discovery through production launch, helping customers redesign business processes around AI while ensuring successful technical delivery. You will serve as a trusted advisor to executives, operators, and technical teams, helping customers define requirements, scope solutions, drive adoption, and realize measurable business outcomes. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success while helping shape the future of how enterprises deploy voice AI. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working directly with customers, and owning outcomes from strategy through execution, this role offers an opportunity to operate at the center of one of the fastest-growing categories in AI. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead end-to-end customer deployments from discovery through production launch, owning project execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful delivery. Partner directly with customers to understand business goals, gather requirements, and translate them into scalable AI-powered workflows. Design conversational workflows, automation strategies, and deployment architectures that deliver measurable business outcomes. Coordinate across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to unblock deployments and ensure customer success. Translate customer feedback into actionable product recommendations and help shape the future direction of the Retell platform. Develop repeatable deployment playbooks, best practices, and frameworks that enable customers to deploy voice AI successfully at scale. Enjoy acting as a trusted advisor and influencing decisions across multiple stakeholders. Have a strong ownership mentality and are willing to do whatever is necessary to drive successful outcomes. Enjoy managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Are highly organized, execution-oriented, and able to move initiatives from concept to production. Have experience in deployment, implementation, solutions consulting, product management, forward deployed engineering, strategic consulting, or other customer-facing technology roles. Have experience writing requirements, implementation plans, PRDs, or project specifications. Have experience building business cases, performing ROI analysis, or conducting value-based solution scoping. Are excited about AI, LLMs, voice technology, and helping customers adopt cutting-edge technologies. Enjoy learning new systems, becoming a domain expert, and solving difficult customer problems. Are comfortable navigating technical conversations even if you are not a full-time engineer. Want to operate at the intersection of technology, product, strategy, and customer success at one of the fastest-growing AI companies.
